title: KS-2194: refresh @hono/node-server 2.1.5 -> 2.1.8 in the root and mcp-server locks
body:
## Linear

https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-2194

## Summary

Refs KS-2194. An in-range, lock-only refresh of `@hono/node-server` 2.1.5 -> 2.1.8 in the two lockfiles that carry it: `Blockchain/Dev/package-lock.json` and `Blockchain/Dev/services/mcp-server/package-lock.json`. Two advisories published 2026-11-12 (GHSA-qv5m-9pm6-hqp3 and GHSA-jpvv-r467-5p4w, vulnerable `>= 2.0.0, < 2.1.6`, first patched 2.1.6) made pre-push legs 6 and 7 refuse every push from develop. No `package.json` edit, no `audit-baseline.json` row, no code change.

Before this deploys: nothing deploys from this PR; deploy is Kam's tap.

## Test Evidence

**Node line.** Every runner figure below was measured on host Node v26.8.1 with npm 11.19.0. None was measured on Node 24, the LTS line the repo's runtime rule names. The docker `node:24-alpine` route was not run (each host diff is exactly +3 -3, so it was not required).

**Touched.** Exactly two files, 3 lines changed in each (`git diff --numstat` reads `3 3` for both; `git show --stat` reads 6 insertions, 6 deletions). In each lock only the entry `node_modules/@hono/node-server` moved: `version` 2.1.5 -> 2.1.8, `resolved` ...-2.1.8.tgz, `integrity` sha512-jdf7FHh6...Qv7bEA== (equal to `npm view @hono/node-server@2.1.8 dist.integrity`). No `libc`, `os` or `cpu` line appears in either diff. The root lock was refreshed in place with `npm update @hono/node-server --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts`; mcp-server's in an isolated copy of its `package.json` and lock with the same verb, then copied back (an npm command inside a workspace member rewrites the root lock instead). Both `package.json` files unchanged (`git diff --quiet` rc 0). `scripts/audit/audit-baseline.json` sha256 `d6e7f1ed1175cec9e567e37f4eb98ce1661d07499f711a9e7c4a0650f6fd21aa` before and after, 0 lines naming hono.

**Ran** (throwaway tree at the develop pin `dc57df60a959` = BEFORE, throwaway tree at this head `15914b780cb6` = AFTER, each a fresh clone plus `npm ci --ignore-scripts`):

| Instrument | BEFORE (pin) | AFTER (this head) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| root `npm ci --ignore-scripts` | rc 0 | rc 0 |
| leg 6, `npm run audit:gate` | rc 1, "7 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined", the two new ids named | rc 0, "5 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined", "OK - no advisories outside the triaged baseline" |
| leg 7, `npm run audit:locks` | rc 1, "45 standalone lockfiles", "FAIL - 2 advisories in standalone locks and NOT in the baseline", both in services/mcp-server | rc 0, "45 standalone lockfiles", "OK - no standalone-lock advisories outside the triaged baseline" |
| the two ids in the gate and locks output | gate 2 and 2, locks 1 and 1 (the control) | 0 and 0 in both outputs |
| `npm run audit:contract` | rc 0, 62 of 62 | rc 0, 62 of 62 |
| census, JSON parse of all 47 tracked locks (planted positive, nested, negative and legacy controls pass) | 2 locks at 2.1.5, 45 with none | 2 locks at 2.1.8, 45 with none |
| `npm ls @hono/node-server --package-lock-only --all` (root) | 2.1.5 under `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.32.1 and under `@prisma/dev` 0.24.3 (deduped) | 2.1.8 under both, 0 occurrences of 2.1.5 |
| mcp-server: `npm ci --ignore-scripts` from its standalone lock, then `npm ls` | rc 0, 2.1.5 under the SDK | rc 0, 2.1.8 under the SDK, 0 occurrences of 2.1.5 |
| mcp-server whole suite (`vitest run`) | 15 of 15 files, 137 of 137 tests | 15 of 15 files, 137 of 137 tests |
| mcp-server `tsc --noEmit` | rc 0, 0 errors | rc 0, 0 errors |

The mcp-server suite ran the way its Dockerfile builds it: standalone-lock `npm ci --ignore-scripts` in an isolated copy, then `node_modules/@secuura/shared` linked to a `packages/shared` built by its own `npm ci` and `npm run build` (the Dockerfile's shared-builder stage). An earlier run in an isolated copy without that link failed 5 of 15 files (62 passed, 75 skipped) on a missing `@secuura/shared/zod3-compat`; it is discarded, not counted, and kept in the seat's evidence folder. The 2.1.6 -> 2.1.8 code changes sit in stream handling that the MCP SDK's HTTP transport uses (the drafter's read of the dist diff; this seat did not re-diff it), which is why the whole suite was re-run AFTER.

**The pre-push hook at this branch** (a real run of `.githooks/pre-push` on host Node v26.8.1 from my own clone; the push exited rc 0 after 14 min 16 s, and `git ls-remote` then read this head on origin). Its final verdict, verbatim:

> PREFLIGHT INCOMPLETE — 13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED. Nothing failed.
> legs 3 4 8 — local stack not up; you can clear this by starting it.
> This is NOT a pass. Do not quote it as one — say which legs ran.

Ran, nothing failed (13 legs): 1 OpenAPI spec drift (OK); 2 lockfile clean-room (all 35 standalone locks pass `npm ci --dry-run`, services/mcp-server among them); 5 audit-contract suites (62 of 62); 6 npm-audit gate ("5 distinct advisories reported, 5 baselined", OK); 7 standalone-lock advisories ("45 standalone lockfiles", OK); 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14 and 15 (each ended without a FAIL); 16 test-file type-check ratchet (5 services, 0 new errors). **Skipped, not run:** leg 3 spec-auth conformance, leg 4 path resolvability, leg 8 served-spec consistency (the local stack was not up on :6882).

**Open PRs on the same lock.** Scan of 90 of 90 open PRs through one GraphQL census, no file list truncated at 100, planted control true, PR 2099 present as the real control: 11 touch `Blockchain/Dev/package-lock.json` (PR 2099, KS-2060, and ten Dependabot PRs: 575, 635, 639, 649, 945, 946, 947, 948, 949, 1965). None touches mcp-server's lock or manifest; PR 945 also edits the root `package.json`. The drafter read PR 2099's lock hunks as two spans near lines 22620 and 22637 to 22690, far from this entry near line 6055; this seat did not re-read those hunks. The list at the pre-push scan equals the list at the first scan (same PR numbers and heads).

**NOT run / not covered.** No runtime exercise of the MCP server against a live HTTP client. No image build, no deploy, no `az`. Schemathesis, Akto, Playwright and k6 were not run, so the two pre-merge acknowledgment boxes below stay unticked. The hook's skipped legs are listed above. `services/originate` is not changed: its `@hono/node-server` override is inert there (0 hono entries in its lock, `grep -c -i hono` = 0). The docker `node:24-alpine` route and any registry write: not done.

**Migrations and config.** None.

**Docs.** No test is added or changed, so no fragment pair is owed (`.claude/skills/secuura-test-discipline/SKILL.md` section 4, lines 483 to 484: a change that does not affect either doc says so and why). No tier or timing figure moved.

### Pre-merge acknowledgment (author)

- [ ] <!--ack:akto--> **Akto** pre-merge scan: not run for this lock-only change
